snippet.title: Way of the Hunter 2 | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Way of the Hunter 2 marks the next evolution of hunting simulations, built on a brand-new technical foundation to deliver the ultimate hunting experience for years to come.

Developed by Nine Rocks Games, the game introduces a loyal hunting dog that helps track animal signs and follow fleeing prey, growing stronger through training and experience.

Uncover a new story, analyze shots with an improved bullet camera, and manage your progress from unique Hunting Lodges across each territory. With licensed gear from real-world brands, realism is front and center in our next hunting adventure.

Wishlist Way of the Hunter 2 on Steam and stay tuned: http://thqn.net/woth2-steam
